$comment: White-label branding, applied at build time. Edit and rebuild to rebrand. Fields can be overridden per-build with ACP_UI_BRAND_NAME / ACP_UI_BRAND_ICON / ACP_UI_BRAND_WORDMARK. Paths are relative to this repo root and must stay inside it: they are inlined into the bundle as data URIs, so remote URLs are rejected by design (see README, White-label branding).
